stations.noteZh: 哥谭高地西站以北为富人住宅区，旧韦恩庄园位于这一带，后改建为哥谭孤儿院。
stations.noteEn: The area north of Gotham Heights West station has spacious residential estates. The former Wayne Manor here became Gotham Orphanage.

settingSource.note: Manual shoreline trace of the supplied Downtown production setting map, aligned to shared station anchors. Hinckley River banks are traced separately through the bend. Downtown core and southern Tricorner harbor remain in one borough view; Crown Point uses a user-confirmed illustrative site inside Tricorner, without an asserted district boundary.
